findings.title: Root account has active access keys
findings.description: The root account has one or more active access keys.
findings.remediation: Delete root access keys immediately; use IAM roles instead.

findings.title: S3 bucket is publicly accessible via ACL or bucket policy
findings.description: Bucket 'prod-customer-uploads' policy grants public access per S3's policy-status evaluation.
findings.remediation: Review and tighten the bucket policy; remove wildcard Principals.

findings.title: Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on a sensitive port
findings.description: Security group 'db-access' allows inbound MySQL (port 3306) from 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict port 3306 to known IP ranges or a bastion/VPN.

findings.title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
findings.description: RDS instance 'prod-primary' has PubliclyAccessible=true.
findings.remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible to false; access via VPC-internal routes.

findings.title: IAM policy grants wildcard Action and Resource (admin-equivalent)
findings.description: Policy 'legacy-full-access' allows Action:* on Resource:*.
findings.remediation: Scope the policy to least privilege.

findings.title: IAM user has console access but no MFA device
findings.description: IAM user 'j.patel' can sign in with a password but has no MFA device.
findings.remediation: Require MFA for all console users.

findings.title: S3 bucket without account/bucket-level Public Access Block
findings.description: Bucket 'internal-logs-archive' does not have all Public Access Block settings enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable all four Public Access Block settings.

findings.title: RDS instance storage is not encrypted
findings.description: RDS instance 'analytics-replica' does not have storage encryption enabled.
findings.remediation: Create an encrypted snapshot and restore to a new encrypted instance.

findings.title: Lambda secrets-like env vars without KMS encryption
findings.description: Function 'payment-webhook' has env vars named like secrets (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) but no KMS key configured.
findings.remediation: Move secrets to AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store.

findings.title: IAM access key older than 90 days
findings.description: Access key AKIA4EXAMPLE1234567 for user 'ci-deploy-bot' is 214 days old.
findings.remediation: Rotate access keys at least every 90 days.

findings.title: S3 bucket without default server-side encryption
findings.description: Bucket 'marketing-assets' has no default encryption configuration.
findings.remediation: Enable default bucket encryption.

findings.title: VPC has no Flow Logs enabled
findings.description: VPC vpc-0f9e8d7c6b in us-east-1 has no Flow Logs.
findings.remediation: Enable VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs or S3.

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.description: EBS volume vol-0123456789abcdef0 is unencrypted.
findings.remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default for the account/region.

findings.title: Default VPC still present
findings.description: Default VPC vpc-default01 exists in ap-southeast-1.
findings.remediation: Delete unused default VPCs or lock down their default security group.

findings.title: S3 bucket without versioning enabled
findings.description: Bucket 'terraform-state-backups' does not have versioning enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable versioning to protect against accidental deletes.

findings.title: Secrets Manager secret has rotation disabled
findings.description: Secret 'db-creds' does not have automatic rotation enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable automatic rotation using a rotation Lambda.

findings.title: Network Security Group allows inbound from Internet on a sensitive port
findings.description: NSG 'prod-nsg' rule 'allow-rdp-any' allows inbound RDP (port 3389) from the public internet.
findings.remediation: Restrict source to known IP ranges or use Azure Bastion.

findings.title: Storage account allows public blob access
findings.description: Storage account 'sharedassets001' has allowBlobPublicAccess enabled.
findings.remediation: Set allowBlobPublicAccess to false; use SAS tokens or Azure AD auth.

findings.title: Firewall rule allows 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on a sensitive port
findings.description: Firewall rule 'allow-ssh-all' allows inbound SSH (22) from 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict source_ranges to known IPs, or use Identity-Aware Proxy for SSH.

findings.title: GCS bucket grants public access (allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers)
findings.description: Bucket 'gs://staging-build-artifacts' grants role 'roles/storage.objectViewer' to allUsers.
findings.remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bindings; use uniform bucket-level access.
